records.question: How many customers belong to each membership category?
records.gold_sql: SELECT membership, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY membership ORDER BY membership

FROM customers

records.question: For every city, identify the restaurant generating the highest total order revenue. Include the city, restaurant ID, and revenue.
records.gold_sql: WITH restaurant_revenue AS (SELECT r.city_code, o.restaurant_id, SUM(o.order_amount) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.city_code ORDER BY SUM(o.order_amount) DESC, o.restaurant_id ASC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN restaurants r USING (restaurant_id) GROUP BY r.city_code, o.restaurant_id) SELECT city_code, restaurant_id, total_revenue FROM restaurant_revenue WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY city_code
records.pred_sql:
SELECT city_code, restaurant_id, total_revenue
FROM (
    SELECT r.city_code,
           o.restaurant_id,
           SUM(o.order_amount) AS total_revenue,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.city_code ORDER BY SUM(o.order_amount) DESC, o.restaurant_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM orders o
    JOIN restaurants r USING (restaurant_id)
    GROUP BY r.city_code, o.restaurant_id
)
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY city_code ASC

records.question: Divide deliveries into distance groups: under 5 km, from 5 to under 10 km, and 10 km or more. Count deliveries in each group.
records.gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN distance_km < 5 THEN 'Under 5 km' WHEN distance_km < 10 THEN '5 to under 10 km' ELSE '10 km or more' END AS distance_group, COUNT(*) AS delivery_count FROM deliveries WHERE distance_km IS NOT NULL GROUP BY distance_group ORDER BY CASE distance_group WHEN 'Under 5 km' THEN 1 WHEN '5 to under 10 km' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
records.pred_sql:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN distance_km < 5 THEN 'Under 5 km'
        WHEN distance_km >= 5 AND distance_km < 10 THEN '5 to under 10 km'
        ELSE '10 km or more'
    END AS distance_group,
    COUNT(*) AS delivery_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE distance_km IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY distance_group
ORDER BY delivery_count DESC, distance_group ASC
